pairs.difference: Both whistles are one smooth lacquered orange plastic with no grain or wear. A is crisp with a clean metal ring. B has a soft glow haze around the body, a blurrier edge and a washed-out background. Neither gives a clear material tell.
pairs.fix: Keep the whistle's gloss in patches, with matte areas on the body. Remove the glow haze and keep edges crisp.

pairs.difference: A has a thick, puffy rope knot and fat tassels with only a few deep folds, so they read as chunky toy blobs. B has a fine twisted rope wrapped in many tight turns and thin tassel strands, which is closer to the small-scale rope detail on real cards. The brass is equally glossy on both.
pairs.fix: Draw the rope as thin twisted strands wrapped tightly, with small thin tassels. Do not use fat, puffy knots. Make the brass less uniformly shiny.

pairs.difference: B has a raised, puffy blue flower and leaves on the cup, and a thick glossy rim with a big liquid highlight. All of it reads as inflated plastic. A has a thin, flat, painted-on flower and a fine rim, like glazed ceramic with a printed decal.
pairs.fix: Paint the flower flat on the porcelain like a printed decal, with fine leaf lines. Use a thin rim and a soft, limited highlight.

pairs.difference: B has glossy, smooth, near-identical apples with clean leaves, and a flat uniform gingham cloth. The basket weave is thick and rounded. A has apples with fine speckles and uneven color, and a finer braided handle, with a softer cloth.
pairs.fix: Give the apple skin tiny speckles and uneven color, and limit the highlights. Make the weave strands thinner and the cloth softer.

pairs.difference: B has oversized domed rivets on every hoop, large decorative wood grain swirls, and saturated, evenly shiny staves. A has fine, quiet scratchy grain, plain matte-satin metal bands without rivets, and subtle variation between staves.
pairs.fix: Use fine, faint wood grain and satin metal bands. Make the rivets small or leave them out. Keep the wood matte.

pairs.difference: A has a uniformly lacquered, chunky body, with fat glossy chrome bumper and grille and a big sparkly windshield highlight. B has a softer body, thin wipers and a finer grille. Its chrome and glass are more restrained.
pairs.fix: Make the paint satin with a few highlights. Make the chrome thinner and the glass dull. Add small details such as wipers.

pairs.difference: A is full of toy-like details: thick rope wraps, round button tabs, a quilted red mat and a lantern. B has smooth, soft canvas with large soft folds and almost no small detail. B's surface is blurry and painterly but plausible. A's chunky props lean generated.
pairs.fix: Use thinner rope, small stitched seams and fine canvas weave, with a matte surface. Do not use fat round tabs and puffy cushions.

pairs.difference: A has a smooth, glossy dark pot with big soft highlights, chunky stones and logs, and a cartoon soup. B has speckled, gritty cast-iron with sooty wear near the fire, which reads as real metal, though the speckle is a little noisy.
pairs.fix: Make the pot matte cast iron with fine grit, soot and a few dull highlights. Use smaller stones and logs.

pattern: Generated cards are uniformly glossy and puffy. Their details are oversized: fat rope, domed rivets, raised decals, big grain. Real cards have finer and quieter details, a mix of matte and shiny, and some small-scale wear or speckle.
